subject: STABLE 2 compiler-speed-opus: build-flavour results (Rust LTO -3%, Mesa O3+NDEBUG -12% Mali only) + gate; HEAVY RELEASE
body: All host, 142-record corpus, byte-identical outputs in every variant (284/284 cache entries, 142/142 Mali digests). (b) Rust fat LTO + codegen-units=1 on the bridge (speed1 sources): air 12.2 -> 11.9 ms (-2.5..-3.3%, 3 interleaved pairs), cdylib 119.4 -> 107.5 MB, build 7m00 vs 7m35 at -j4; keep panic=unwind (air_bridge.rs catch_unwind). Low value; optional for the iOS staticlib (smaller code to page in). (a) Mesa release (O3+NDEBUG, private static libs in compile-speed-20261026/mesa-rel): Mali on folded captures 2.78 -> 2.42 ms (-12%), unfolded no gain; = ~2% of a miss after the translator fixes. NOT recommended: NDEBUG turns Mesa asserts (today a SIGABRT we can see) into UB. Device NIR validation is already off via NIR_DEBUG=novalidate. (d) key normalization: 142 corpus AIR keys -> 129 distinct Mali inputs -> 129 distinct Mali outputs (no Mali over-keying); 13 AIR keys differ only by blend factors (12) or target format 115 vs 80 (1) yet give identical SPIR-V+spec: the translator's own per-stage FunctionCompileKey (Device::render_pipeline_key + StageSource::Compiled, a caller-owned cache the translator documents) would let air_bridge.rs reuse those stage compiles exactly; compute owns air_bridge.rs, so recommendation only, ~9% of AIR misses in this corpus. Projected device per fixed_frag miss (scale from c6l: AIR x8.7, Mali x5.75 vs host base): base ~1200 ms (log 762+442); fold ~182; fold+decode/fingerprint ~127; +LTO ~120; Mali prefold alone (if the translator fold is not adopted) Mali 442 -> ~305 ms. Gate: run_host_tests.sh NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN=/usr/bin with LD_LIBRARY_PATH=private prefold Mali lib passed every section through arch9 Mesa compiler / real linked arch9 graphics compiler / graphics descriptors (42 PASS lines), then aborted at '== Metal/JM transport lifetime' tests/nord2_metal_bridge_test.c:460 n2mb_draw_v4: that test does not link Mali; metal/nord2_metal_bridge.c and the test were being edited by another owner at 22:55/22:57 during my run. Not run by me: integration --candidate, render harness, CA test (they need root's rebuild of the shared host Mali lib from mali_graphics_compiler.c be411e7a; I did not touch shared libs). HEAVY RELEASE.
